procedure_summary: Compound I and sodium trifluoroethoxide are reacted in a reaction solvent with an alkali metal hydroxide or carbonate added, giving the trifluoroethoxymethyl benzoic acid. No workup, isolation or yield is stated.
notes: PROSE step, from the numbered recitation of the route in 发明内容. The prose step count is 2 and agrees with A0's estimate of 2; the two further records in this file are the two drawn arrows required by rule 5f and are not a disagreement about the prose. ONE POT, and the reason matters. The prose describes one operation and names one product, but compound I is a methyl ester and compound II is the free acid, and equation (1) writes CH3OH and NaBr as by-products, so two transformations occur under one charge with no workup between them. notes: PROSE step, document marker 步骤b. The defect is in the span, and any consumer reading only the span will draw the wrong conclusion here. No flag in the closed list covers an unbalanced drawn equation, and the two mass-related flags need stated masses or moles, of which this section has none.
